title: Deadline Extended: Indomie Undergraduate Scholarship Program 2026
summary: Newly admitted 100L and Direct Entry students can apply for the Indomie Undergraduate Scholarship Program, offering full tuition, monthly stipends, accommodation and book support, and mentorship.
details:
The deadline for the Indomie Undergraduate Scholarship Program 2026 has been extended.

The scholarship gives eligible Nigerian students entering tertiary education in the 2026/2027 academic session an opportunity to receive financial and academic support throughout their undergraduate programme, subject to the required academic performance.

CATEGORY

Scholarship

ELIGIBILITY

- Newly admitted undergraduate students, including 100L and Direct Entry students.
- Applicants must have gained admission to or be enrolled in a full-time accredited undergraduate programme.

BENEFITS

- Full tuition scholarship.
- Monthly stipends.
- Accommodation and book support.
- Mentorship.

HOW TO APPLY

1. Visit the official Indomie Scholarship Program application portal.
2. Click "I Am a New Applicant" to begin.
3. Enter your name, email address, phone number, date of birth and state of origin.
4. Upload a passport photograph. The portal also allows applicants to use their phone camera to take the photograph.
5. Upload your JAMB and O'Level results. Applicants who do not have the documents ready during registration can skip this step and log in later to upload them before the deadline.
6. Verify your email address or phone number.
7. Submit your application.

SELECTION PROCESS

After applications close, shortlisted candidates will be invited to a Computer-Based Test (CBT). Candidates who are successful at this stage will proceed to physical verification before the final selection.

APPLICATION IS FREE

There is no application fee. Applicants do not need to pay anyone to submit an application.

APPLICATION LINK

Apply through the official portal: https://indomie.ng/indomie-scholarship-program/

DEADLINE

September 30, 2026.

Applicants are advised to complete and submit their applications before the deadline.

title: JUST IN: JOSEPH AYO BABALOLA UNIVERSITY ANNOUNCES RESUMPTION DATES FOR 2026/2027 ACADEMIC SESSION

details:
The Management of Joseph Ayo Babalola University (JABU), Ikeji-Arakeji, Osun State, has announced the resumption dates for fresh and returning students for the 2026/2027 academic session.

The announcement was contained in a welcome message from the Vice-Chancellor, Professor Olasebikan Alade Fakolujo, who warmly welcomed students, staff, parents and other stakeholders to the new academic session.

JABU 2026/2027 RESUMPTION DATES

Freshers' Resumption: Monday, September 21, 2026
Parents' Forum, First Semester: Saturday, September 26, 2026
Returning Students' Resumption: Saturday, September 26, 2026

FRESHERS TO RESUME ON SEPTEMBER 21

Newly admitted students are expected to resume on Monday, September 21, 2026. Freshers are advised to make the necessary preparations ahead of the resumption date and ensure that they complete all required admission and registration procedures.

Students should also stay updated through the university's official communication channels for information concerning clearance, accommodation, school fees, orientation and other registration requirements.

RETURNING STUDENTS TO RESUME ON SEPTEMBER 26

Returning students are scheduled to resume for the new academic session on Saturday, September 26, 2026.

Students are encouraged to prepare adequately for the commencement of academic activities, complete any outstanding registration requirements and report to their respective departments as directed by the university.

PARENTS' FORUM SCHEDULED FOR SEPTEMBER 26

The university also announced that the First Semester Parents' Forum will hold on Saturday, September 26, 2026.

The forum is expected to provide an opportunity for parents and guardians to engage with the university's management, receive important updates and discuss matters relating to students' welfare, academic progress and general campus activities.

VICE-CHANCELLOR WELCOMES THE UNIVERSITY COMMUNITY

In his welcome message, the Vice-Chancellor, Professor Olasebikan Alade Fakolujo, extended warm greetings to students, staff, parents and all stakeholders as the university begins the 2026/2027 academic session.

The university community is expected to approach the new session with renewed commitment to academic excellence, discipline, personal development and the values of the institution.

ADVICE TO STUDENTS AND PARENTS

Students and parents are advised to:
Take note of the announced resumption dates.
Make adequate travel and accommodation arrangements.
Complete all necessary payments, clearance and registration processes.
Monitor official university platforms for further announcements.
Avoid relying on unverified information from unofficial social media pages.

The university's official website and student portals should be consulted for additional instructions and updates concerning the new academic session.

Joseph Ayo Babalola University wishes all students, staff, parents and stakeholders a successful and rewarding 2026/2027 academic session.

title: 𝐅𝐞𝐝 𝐆𝐨𝐯𝐭 𝐀𝐩𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐬 𝐓𝐚𝐤𝐞𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐎𝐟 𝐇𝐍𝐃 𝐀𝐝𝐦𝐢𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬 𝐁𝐲 𝐉𝐀𝐌𝐁
summary: The federal government has approved the takeover of Higher National Diploma admissions by the Joint Admissions and Matriculation Board (JAMB), with all HND admissions to be processed through JAMB from the current admission session.
details:
The federal government has approved the takeover of Higher National Diploma admissions by the Joint Admissions and Matriculation Board (JAMB).

The move is aimed at ending illegal and compromised admissions in polytechnics and other institutions offering HND programmes.

The National Board for Technical Education (NBTE), disclosed this in a circular dated September 9, 2026 signed by its executive secretary, Prof Idris Bugaje, which was obtained by LEADERSHIP Weekend yesterday.

The circular followed a meeting between the Minister of Education, Dr Tunji Alausa, and key stakeholders, including JAMB, the National Youth Service Corps, NBTE and the Federal Ministry of Education.

Under the new arrangement, all HND admissions across institutions are to be processed through JAMB from the current admission session.

According to NBTE, the centralised system is intended to address irregularities in the admission process and prevent situations where students with questionable admissions are later denied mobilisation for the NYSC after completing their HND programmes.

The board said, “All HND admissions in all institutions shall from this session be taken over by JAMB to provide centralised process and avoid illegal and compromised admissions, jeopardising students’ mobilisation for NYSC after HND.”

It added that the Federal Ministry of Education would issue a detailed statement on the new arrangement next week.

NBTE also said it would immediately develop comprehensive HND admission guidelines and submit them to JAMB to guide the digital admission platform.

“The decisions taken and approved by the Hon Minister for immediate implementation are as follows: All HND admissions in all Institutions shall from this session be taken over by JAMB to provide centralised process and avoid illegal and compromised admissions, jeopardising students mobilisation for NYSC after HND. The FME shall issue a statement on this next week with further details,” the circular stated.

The guidelines, according to the board, will address issues including the required waiting period for National Diploma holders before proceeding to HND, as well as exemptions for certain ND health-related programmes.

The board also announced a new ceiling for part-time National Diploma admissions, following the decision to bring all part-time ND admissions under JAMB.

It said the proportion of part-time students would now be limited to 50 per cent of an institution’s approved full-time admission quota.

“Now that all part-time ND admissions are under the JAMB, the proportion of part-time students is pegged at 50 per cent of the approved full-time quota,” the circular stated.

The federal government also reaffirmed an earlier NBTE directive concerning holders of combined NCE and HND qualifications and their eligibility for NYSC mobilisation.

NBTE had, in a circular issued on September 7, prohibited the presentation of candidates with an NCE/HND combination for NYSC mobilisation.

title: LAGOS STATE UNIVERSITY ANNOUNCE ONLINE ADMISSION SCREENING EXERCISE FOR DIRECT ENTRY CANDIDATES
summary: Lagos State University has announced the 2026/2027 Online Admission Screening Exercise for Direct Entry candidates. The screening is mandatory for eligible candidates seeking admission into LASU through Direct Entry.
details:
Applications are invited from suitably qualified candidates for the Lagos State University 2026/2027 Admission Screening Exercise for Regular Students seeking admission via Direct Entry. The online screening exercise is mandatory for entry into Lagos State University.

ELIGIBILITY FOR SCREENING

All Direct Entry candidates, including LASU Foundation (JUPEB), who wish to be considered for admission into Lagos State University for the 2026/2027 Academic Session must have obtained the Direct Entry Form from JAMB and chosen Lagos State University as their first choice institution. Only the LASU Diploma is acceptable for Direct Entry admission, except NCE into Faculty of Education programmes.

Candidates of Lagos State origin, for 100 and 200 levels, who have proven their claims before the Independent Indigeneship Verification Committee (IIVC) will have their claims automatically validated in the Online Admission Screening Exercise.

NOTE TO ALL DIRECT ENTRY CANDIDATES

All Direct Entry candidates are expected to immediately submit a copy each of the online Admission Screening Report and the notification of Diploma (LASU Diploma)/NCE Result at the Admission Annex/Liaison Office, Room 7, Administrative Block II.

METHOD OF APPLICATION

Prospective candidates should visit the LASU website, point to Student and click New Applicants, then UTME/DE Screening. Click DE CANDIDATE LOGIN, enter your UTME Registration Number and surname, submit, and proceed to make payment for Admission Screening. After successful payment, return to the dashboard and click Start Admission Screening. Supply the required information and Transaction ID, then continue with the self-screening process.

O'LEVEL REQUIREMENTS

Candidates must possess five O'Level credit passes in subjects relevant to their desired course of study at not more than two sittings, except Medicine and Dentistry which require only one sitting. Engineering candidates using two sittings must possess six O'Level credit passes including Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, English Language, two other science subjects and any other subject. Aeronautic and Astronautic Engineering requires a credit pass in Further Mathematics. A credit pass in English Language is compulsory for admission into all courses in Lagos State University.

Candidates must ensure they upload their O'Level results on JAMB CAPS before the closure of the Admission Screening Exercise. Any examination taken after July 2026 is not acceptable.

SCREENING GRADING

Screening will be based on the Point Grading System using the UTME score and SSCE or equivalent grades in five best relevant subjects for the candidate's choice of course. Candidates are advised to study the O'Level subject requirements for their course of choice before participating in the online screening.

APPLICATION PERIOD

Payment and registration/updating will last for two weeks, from 12 September 2026 until 26 September 2026 at 12 midnight.

All Online Screening complaints should be directed to screeningsupport@lasu.edu.ng.

summary:
The Lagos State Government has approved the domestication and implementation of agreements covering staff unions in Lagos State-owned universities and other tertiary institutions, in a major development towards resolving the ongoing industrial action.
The approval covers new allowances for academic and non-academic staff, with implementation effective from January 1, 2026. Accumulated arrears will be paid in two tranches alongside the October and November 2026 salaries, while the approved allowances will be tax-free.
Following the approval, the State Government has appealed to the unions to discontinue the ongoing strike and resume work immediately.

lementation%20of%20the%20approval%20in%20line%20with%20existing%20financial%20regulations.%22%7D%2C%7B%22type%22%3A%22image%22%2C%22url%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Frajbswknmdscrilrcwoj.supabase.co%2Fstorage%2Fv1%2Fobject%2Fpublic%2Fnews-attachments%2Fimages%2F14bbd7ea-7004-4c86-9fe6-d67235683293.jpg%22%2C%22alt%22%3A%22%22%7D%2C%7B%22type%22%3A%22paragraph%22%2C%22text%22%3A%22%F0%9D%97%9F%F0%9D%97%94%F0%9D%97%9A%F0%9D%97%A2%F0%9D%97%A6%20%F0%9D%97%9A%F0%9D%97%A2%F0%9D%97%A9%F0%9D%97%A7%20%F0%9D%97%A8%F0%9D%97%A5%F0%9D%97%9A%F0%9D%97%98%F0%9D%97%A6%20%F0%9D%97%98%F0%9D%97%A1%F0%9D%97%97%20%F0%9D%97%A7%F0%9D%97%A2%20%F0%9D%97%A6%F0%9D%97%A7%F0%9D%97%A5%F0%9D%97%9C%F0%9D%97%9E%F0%9D%97%98%5Cn%5CnFollowing%20the%20approval%2C%20the%20Lagos%20State%20Government%20appealed%20to%20the%20leadership%20of%20the%20unions%20to%20direct%20their%20members%20to%20**discontinue%20the%20ongoing%20strike%20action%20and%20resume%20work%20with%20immediate%20effect**.%5Cn%5CnCommissioner%20for%20Tertiary%20Education%20Tolani%20Sule%20appreciated%20the%20unions%20for%20their%20patience%2C%20maturity%20and%20understanding%20during%20the%20negotiation%20period%20and%20urged%20members%20to%20continue%20to%20maintain%20industrial%20peace%20and%20remain%20dedicated%20to%20their%20duties.%5Cn%5Cn%F0%9D%97%AA%F0%9D%97%9B%F0%9D%97%94%F0%9D%97%A7%20%F0%9D%97%A7%F0%9D%97%9B%F0%9D%97%9C%F0%9D%97%A6%20%F0%9D%97%A0%F0%9D%97%98%F0%9D%97%94%F0%9D%97%A1%F0%9D%97%A6%20%F0%9D%97%99%F0%9D%97%A2%F0%9D%97%A5%20%F0%9D%97%A6%F0%9D%97%A7%F0%9D%97%A8%F0%9D%97%97%F0%9D%97%98%F0%9D%97%A1%F0%9D%97%A7%F0%9D%97%A6%5Cn%5CnThe%20approval%20represents%20a%20major%20step%20towards%20resolving%20the%20industrial%20action%20affecting%20Lagos%20State-owned%20universities.%5Cn%5CnWith%20the%20government%20directing%20the%20immediate%20implementation%20of%20the%20agreements%2C%20attention%20now%20shifts%20to%20the%20unions'%20response%20and%20an%20expected%20announcement%20concerning%20the%20suspension%20of%20the%20strike%20and%20resumption%20of%20normal%20academic%20activities.%5Cn%5CnStudents%20are%20advised%20to%20monitor%20official%20communications%20from%20their%20respective%20institutions%20and%20union%20leadership%20for%20further%20developments.%22%7D%5D]

title: FEDERAL UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY & ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENCES, IYIN-EKITI (FUTES-IYIN) GETS NUC FULL APPROVAL FOR ADDITIONAL ACADEMIC PROGRAMMES
institution: FEDERAL UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY & ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENCES, IYIN-EKITI (FUTES-IYIN)
summary:
The Federal University of Technology and Environmental Sciences, Iyin-Ekiti (FUTES-IYIN), has reopened its 2026/2027 admission portal following the approval of three additional academic programmes by the National Universities Commission (NUC).
The newly approved programmes are Artificial Intelligence, Telecommunication Science, and Tourism & Hospitality Management.
The reopening gives prospective students another opportunity to apply to the University, particularly candidates interested in the newly introduced programmes. Applications will run from Tuesday, October 6 to Tuesday, October 13, 2026.
Prospective applicants are expected to complete the necessary admission procedures within the application window, including the appropriate JAMB change of institution and programme where required.

[SOH_BLOCKS:%5B%7B%22type%22%3A%22paragraph%22%2C%22text%22%3A%22The%20**National%20Universities%20Commission%20(NUC)**%20has%20approved%20three%20additional%20academic%20programmes%20for%20the%20**Federal%20University%20of%20Technology%20and%20Environmental%20Sciences%2C%20Iyin-Ekiti%20(FUTES-IYIN)**%20as%20the%20institution%20prepares%20for%20its%20second%20academic%20session.%5Cn%5CnThe%20approval%20expands%20the%20University's%20academic%20offerings%20and%20introduces%20programmes%20covering%20emerging%20technology%2C%20telecommunications%2C%20tourism%20and%20hospitality.%5Cn%5CnThe%20development%20has%20also%20prompted%20the%20University%20to%20reopen%20its%20**2026%2F2027%20admission%20portal**%2C%20creating%20an%20additional%20application%20window%20for%20prospective%20students%20seeking%20admission%20into%20the%20newly%20approved%20programmes.%5Cn%5CnAccording%20to%20the%20University%2C%20the%20NUC%20approval%20was%20conveyed%20in%20a%20letter%20dated%20**September%2011%2C%202026**%2C%20following%20a%20resource%20verification%20exercise%20conducted%20at%20FUTES-IYIN%20on%20**August%2027%2C%202026**.%5Cn%5CnDuring%20the%20exercise%2C%20the%20Commission's%20team%20assessed%20the%20human%20and%20material%20resources%20available%20for%20the%20proposed%20programmes%2C%20including%20relevant%20facilities%20and%20personnel.%5Cn%5CnThe%20subsequent%20approval%20allows%20FUTES-IYIN%20to%20formally%20offer%20the%20programmes%20as%20part%20of%20its%20expanding%20academic%20portfolio.%5Cn%5Cn%F0%9D%97%A1%F0%9D%97%98%F0%9D%97%AA%F0%9D%97%9F%F0%9D%97%AC%20%F0%9D%97%94%F0%9D%97%A3%F0%9D%97%A3%F0%9D%97%A5%F0%9D%97%A2%F0%9D%97%A9%F0%9D%97%98%F0%9D%97%97%20%F0%9D%97%A3%F0%9D%97%A5%F0%9D%97%A2%F0%9D%97%9A%F0%9D%97%A5%F0%9D%97%94%F0%9D%97%A0%F0%9D%97%A0%F0%9D%97%98%F0%9D%97%A6%5Cn%5CnThe%20three%20newly%20approved%20programmes%20are%3A%5Cn%5Cn-%20**Artificial%20Intelligence**%5Cn-%20**Telecommunication%20Science**%5Cn-%20**Tourism%20%26%20Hospitality%20Management**%5CnThe%20addition%20of%20Artificial%20Intelligence%20further%20strengthens%20the%20University's%20technology-focused%20academic%20direction%20at%20a%20time%20when%20AI%20skills%20and%20applications%20are%20becoming%20increasingly%20important%20across%20industries.%5Cn%5CnTelecommunication%20Science%20expands%20opportunities%20for%20students%20interested%20in%20communication%20technologies%20and%20related%20areas%2C%20while%20Tourism%20%26%20Hospitality%20Management%20broadens%20the%20institution's%20academic%20offerings%20beyond%20its%20existing%20science%20and%20technology%20programmes.%5Cn%5CnTogether%2C%20the%20programmes%20provide%20additional%20choices%20for%20candidates%20seeking%20admission%20into%20FUTES-IYIN%20during%20the%202026%2F2027%20academic%20session.%5Cn%5Cn%F0%9D%97%A9%F0%9D%97%9C%F0%9D%97%96%F0%9D%97%98-%F0%9D%97%96%F0%9D%97%9B%F0%9D%97%94%F0%9D%97%A1%F0%9D%97%96%F0%9D%97%98%F0%9D%97%9F%F0%9D%97%9F%F0%9D%97%A2%F0%9D%97%A5%20%F0%9D%97%A6%F0%9D%97%A3%F0%9D%97%98%F0%9D%97%94%F0%9D%97%9E%F0%9D%97%A6%20%F0%9D%97%A2%F0%9D%97%A1%20%F0%9D%97%A1%F0%9D%97%98%F0%9D%97%AA%20%F0%9D%97%A3%F0%9D%97%A5%F0%9D%97%A2%F0%9D%97%9A%F0%9D%97%A5%F0%9D%97%94%F0%9D%97%A0%F0%9D%97%A0%F0%9D%97%98%F0%9D%97%A6%5Cn%5CnSpeaking%20on%20the%20development%2C%20the%20Vice-Chancellor%2C%20**Professor%20Gbenga%20Aribisala**%2C%20said%20the%20newly%20approved%20programmes%20were%20designed%20to%20respond%20to%20emerging%20national%20and%20global%20needs%20while%20complementing%20the%20University's%20technological%20and%20environmental%20mandate.%5Cn%5CnHe%20explained%20that%20the%20institution%20was%20not%20expanding%20its%20academic%20offerings%20merely%20to%20increase%20student%20enrolment%2C%20but%20was%20placing%20emphasis%20on%20**relevance%2C%20quality%20and%20alignment%20with%20the%20University's%20vision**.%5Cn%5CnAccording%20to%20the%20Vice-Chancellor%2C%20the%20University%20had%20deliberately%20worked%20towards%20providing%20the%20human%20and%20physical%20resources%20necessary%20to%20support%20the%20programmes.%5Cn%5CnHe%20maintained%20that%20the%20expansion%20of%20the%20University's%20academic%20offerings%20would%20not%20be%20pursued%20at%20the%20expense%20of%20quality.%5Cn%5CnThe%20NUC%20approval%20consequently%20represents%20another%20stage%20in%20the%20development%20of%20the%20young%20federal%20university%20as%20it%20works%20to%20expand%20its%20academic%20capacity%20while%20strengthening%20the%20structures%20established%20during%20its%20first%20academic%20session.%5Cn%5Cn%F0%9D%97%99%F0%9D%97%A8%F0%9D%97%A7%F0%9D%97%98%F0%9D%97%A6-%F0%9D%97%9C%F0%9D%97%AC%F0%9D%97%9C%F0%9D%97%A1%20%F0%9D%97%A5%F0%9D%97%98%F0%9D%97%A2%F0%9D%97%A3%F0%9D%97%98%F0%9D%97%A1%F0%9D%97%A6%20%F0%9D%9F%AE%F0%9D%9F%AC%F0%9D%9F%AE%F0%9D%9F%B2%2F%F0%9D%9F%AE%F0%9D%9F%AC%F0%9D%9F%AE%F0%9D%9F%B3%20%F0%9D%97%94%F0%9D%97%97%F0%9D%97%A0%F0%9D%97%9C%F0%9D%97%A6%F0%9D%97%A6%F0%9D%97%9C%F0%9D%97%A2%F0%9D%97%A1%20%F0%9D%97%A3%F0%9D%97%A2%F0%9D%97%A5%F0%9D%97%A7%F0%9D%97%94%F0%9D%97%9F%5Cn%5CnFollowing%20the%20approval%20of%20the%20three%20programmes%2C%20FUTES-IYIN%20has%20reopened%20its%20admission%20portal%20for%20prospective%20candidates.%5Cn%5CnThe%20University%20had%20earlier%20commenced%20its%202026%2F2027%20admission%20exercise%20before%20closing%20the%20initial%20screening%20registration%20window.%5Cn%5CnThe%20latest%20reopening%20provides%20another%20opportunity%20for%20candidates%2C%20particularly%20those%20seeking%20admission%20into%20**Artificial%20Intelligence%2C%20Telecommunication%20Science%2C%20and%20Tourism%20%26%20Hospitality%20Management**%2C%20to%20participate%20in%20the%20ongoing%20admission%20exercise.%5Cn%5CnThe%20portal%20will%20remain%20open%20for%20one%20week.%5Cn%5Cn**%F0%9D%97%A2%F0%9D%97%BD%F0%9D%97%B2%F0%9D%97%BB%F0%9D%97%B6%F0%9D%97%BB%F0%9D%97%B4%20%F0%9D%97%97%F0%9D%97%AE%F0%9D%98%81%F0%9D%97%B2%3A**%20Tuesday%2C%20October%206%2C%202026%5Cn%5Cn**%F0%9D%97%96%F0%9D%97%B9%F0%9D%97%BC%F0%9D%98%80%F0%9D%97%B6%F0%9D%97%BB%F0%9D%97%B4%20%F0%9D%97%97%F0%9D% title: URGENT: JAMB EXTENDS FINAL DEADLINE FOR 2021–2025 OUTSTANDING ADMISSION OFFERS TO NOVEMBER 30
summary: JAMB has extended the deadline for candidates with outstanding admission offers from 2021 to 2025 to 30 November 2026. title: FG DECLARES OCTOBER 1 PUBLIC HOLIDAY FOR NIGERIA’S 66TH INDEPENDENCE ANNIVERSARY

one%20of%20its%20strengths**%2C%20while%20the%20collective%20determination%20of%20its%20citizens%20remains%20important%20to%20building%20a%20stronger%20and%20more%20prosperous%20nation.%5Cn%5Cn**FEDERAL%20GOVERNMENT%20REAFFIRMS%20COMMITMENT%20TO%20NATIONAL%20DEVELOPMENT**%5Cn%5CnDr.%20Tunji-Ojo%20reaffirmed%20the%20Federal%20Government%E2%80%99s%20commitment%20to%20building%20a%20better%20Nigeria%20through%20the%20**Renewed%20Hope%20Agenda**.%5Cn%5CnThe%20Minister%20also%20assured%20Nigerians%20that%20the%20government%20remains%20committed%20to%20**strengthening%20national%20security%2C%20improving%20public%20safety%20and%20creating%20an%20environment%20where%20citizens%20can%20live%2C%20work%20and%20pursue%20their%20legitimate%20aspirations%20with%20confidence**.%5Cn%5CnHe%20described%20these%20efforts%20as%20part%20of%20the%20government%E2%80%99s%20commitment%20to%20national%20development%20and%20a%20befitting%20tribute%20to%20Nigeria%E2%80%99s%20past%20heroes.%5Cn%5Cn**NIGERIANS%20URGED%20TO%20EMBRACE%20PEACEFUL%20COEXISTENCE**%5Cn%5CnAs%20Nigeria%20marks%20its%20**66th%20Independence%20Anniversary**%2C%20citizens%20have%20been%20encouraged%20to%20use%20the%20celebration%20as%20an%20opportunity%20to%20demonstrate%20the%20values%20of%20**unity%2C%20patriotism%2C%20peaceful%20coexistence%20and%20mutual%20respect**.%5Cn%5CnThe%20Federal%20Government%20urged%20Nigerians%20to%20remain%20hopeful%20about%20the%20country%E2%80%99s%20future%20and%20continue%20contributing%20towards%20the%20development%20of%20a%20stronger%20and%20more%20prosperous%20nation.%5Cn%5CnThe%20Independence%20Day%20public%20holiday%20will%20be%20observed%20nationwide%20on%20**Thursday%2C%20October%201%2C%202026**.%5Cn%5CnThe%20statement%20was%20electronically%20signed%20by%20**Dr.%20Magdalene%20Ajani%2C%20Permanent%20Secretary%2C%20Ministry%20of%20Interior**.%22%7D%5D]

[SOH_BLOCKS:%5B%7B%22type%22%3A%22paragraph%22%2C%22text%22%3A%22The%20**Joint%20Admissions%20and%20Matriculation%20Board%20(JAMB)**%20has%20announced%20the%20temporary%20unavailability%20of%20its%20Central%20Admissions%20Processing%20System%20(CAPS)%2C%20citing%20technical%20challenges%20associated%20with%20the%20platform%E2%80%99s%20hosting%20arrangements.%5Cn%5CnThe%20development%20affects%20candidates%2C%20tertiary%20institutions%20and%20other%20users%20who%20rely%20on%20the%20JAMB%20CAPS%20platform%20for%20various%20admission-related%20activities.%5Cn%5CnAccording%20to%20the%20Board%2C%20efforts%20are%20already%20underway%20to%20resolve%20the%20issue%20and%20restore%20the%20platform%20to%20full%20functionality.%5Cn%5Cn**JAMB%20CAPS%20CURRENTLY%20UNAVAILABLE**%5CnJAMB%20disclosed%20that%20the%20Central%20Admissions%20Processing%20System%20(CAPS)%20is%20temporarily%20unavailable%20as%20a%20result%20of%20technical%20challenges%20connected%20with%20its%20hosting%20arrangements.%5Cn%5CnThe%20CAPS%20platform%20plays%20an%20important%20role%20in%20the%20Nigerian%20tertiary%20institution%20admission%20process.%20It%20is%20used%20by%20JAMB%20and%20participating%20institutions%20to%20process%20admissions%20and%20allows%20candidates%20to%20monitor%20important%20updates%20concerning%20their%20admission%20status.%5Cn%5CnThe%20temporary%20disruption%20may%20therefore%20affect%20candidates%20who%20are%20attempting%20to%20access%20their%20CAPS%20profiles%2C%20check%20admission%20updates%20or%20carry%20out%20other%20activities%20requiring%20the%20platform.%5Cn%5Cn%22%2C%22font%22%3A%22Times%20New%20Roman%22%7D%2C%7B%22type%22%3A%22image%22%2C%22url%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Frajbswknmdscrilrcwoj.supabase.co%2Fstorage%2Fv1%2Fobject%2Fpublic%2Fnews-attachments%2Fimages%2F3d2cdc97-f193-4928-860d-25019714ed21.jpg%22%2C%22alt%22%3A%22%22%7D%2C%7B%22type%22%3A%22paragraph%22%2C%22text%22%3A%22**JAMB%20BEGINS%20EFFORTS%20TO%20RESTORE%20CAPS**%5CnIn%20response%20to%20the%20development%2C%20JAMB%20stated%20that%20it%20has%20commenced%20intensive%20engagement%20with%20the%20hosting%20organisation%20to%20identify%20and%20resolve%20the%20technical%20challenges.%5Cn%5CnThe%20Board%20said%20the%20engagement%20is%20aimed%20at%20restoring%20the%20CAPS%20platform%20to%20full%20functionality%20as%20soon%20as%20possible.%5Cn%5CnJAMB%20also%20assured%20candidates%2C%20institutions%20and%20other%20users%20that%20efforts%20are%20ongoing%20to%20address%20the%20situation.%5Cn%5CnThe%20Board%20did%20not%20indicate%20in%20the%20notice%20how%20long%20the%20disruption%20is%20expected%20to%20last.%20Candidates%20are%20therefore%20advised%20to%20await%20further%20communication%20from%20JAMB%20regarding%20the%20restoration%20of%20the%20platform.%5Cn%5Cn**WHAT%20CANDIDATES%20SHOULD%20KNOW**%5CnThe%20temporary%20unavailability%20of%20JAMB%20CAPS%20may%20be%20a%20concern%20for%20candidates%20who%20are%20currently%20awaiting%20admission%20offers%20or%20trying%20to%20monitor%20changes%20to%20their%20admission%20status.%5Cn%5CnCandidates%20who%20are%20unable%20to%20access%20their%20CAPS%20profiles%20during%20this%20period%20should%20not%20immediately%20assume%20that%20there%20has%20been%20a%20change%20or%20problem%20with%20their%20admission%20status.%5Cn%5CnInstead%2C%20applicants%20are%20advised%20to%20remain%20patient%20while%20JAMB%20works%20with%20the%20hosting%20organisation%20to%20resolve%20the%20technical%20issue.%5Cn%5CnCandidates%20should%20also%20avoid%20relying%20on%20information%20from%20unofficial%20sources%2C%20particularly%20claims%20suggesting%20that%20their%20admission%20status%20has%20changed%20simply%20because%20they%20are%20unable%20to%20access%20CAPS.%5Cn%5CnOnce%20the%20platform%20is%20restored%2C%20candidates%20can%20return%20to%20their%20profiles%20and%20continue%20monitoring%20their%20admission%20status%20as%20usual.%5Cn%5Cn**INSTITUTIONS%20ALSO%20AFFECTED**%5CnThe%20disruption%20is%20not%20limited%20to%20individual%20candidates.%5Cn%5CnAccording%20to%20JAMB%E2%80%99s%20notice%2C%20institutions%20and%20other%20users%20are%20also%20affected%20by%20the%20temporary%20unavailability%20of%20the%20CAPS%20platform.%5Cn%5CnTertiary%20institutions%20use%20the%20JAMB%20admission%20processing%20system%20as%20part%20of%20the%20procedures%20involved%20in%20processing%20and%20managing%20admissions.%5Cn%5CnThe%20technical%20challenges%20may%20therefore%20temporarily%20affect%20certain%20admission-related%20activities%20being%20carried%20out%20through%20the%20platform.%5Cn%5CnInstitutions%20and%20admission%20officers%20who%20require%20access%20to%20CAPS%20are%20also%20expected%20to%20wait%20for%20the%20system%20to%20be%20restored%20before%20continuing%20activities%20that%20depend%20on%20the%20platform.%5Cn%5Cn**JAMB%20APPEALS%20FOR%20PATIENCE**%5CnThe%20Board%20expressed%20regret%20over%20the%20inconvenience%20caused%20by%20the%20temporary%20disruption.%5Cn%5CnJAMB%20also%20appreciated%20the%20patience%20and%20understanding%20of%20candidates%2C%20institutions%20and%20other%20users%20while%20efforts%20are%20being%20made%20to%20resolve%20the%20issue.%5Cn%5CnThe%20Board%20stated%20that%20further%20updates%20will%20be%20communicated%20as%20developments%20unfold.%5Cn%5CnCandidates%20are%20therefore%20encouraged%20to%20monitor%20official%20JAMB%20communication%20channels%20for%20verified%20information%20regarding%20the%20status%20of%20the%20CAPS%20platform.%5Cn%5Cn**ADMISSION%20PROCESS%20REMAINS%20SUBJECT%20TO%20OFFICIAL%20UPDATES**%5CnCandidates%20participating%20in%20the%202026%2F2027%20admission%20exercise%20should%20continue%20to%20follow%20official%20instructions%20from%20JAMB%20and%20their%20respective%20institutions.%5Cn%5CnThe%20inability%20to%20access%20CAPS%20temporarily%20should%20not%20be%20interpreted%20as%20a%20final%20indication%20of%20whether%20a%20candidate%20has%20been%20offered%20admission%20or%20not.%5Cn%5CnCandidates%20awaiting%20admission%20are%20encouraged%20to%20remain%20patient%20and%20continue%20checking%20for%20official%20updates%20once%20the%20platform%20becomes%20available%20again.%5Cn%5CnApplicants%20should%20also%20ensure%20that%20they%20keep%20their%20JAMB%20profile%20details%20and%20other%20admission-related%20information%20secure.%5Cn%5Cn**AVOID%20UNOFFICIAL%20ADMISSION%20INFORMATION**%5CnWith%20the%20temporary%20unavailability%20of%20the%20platform%2C%20candidates%20may%20encounter%20individuals%20claiming%20to%20have%20access%20to%20admission%20information%20or%20offering%20to%20check%20or%20manipulate%20CAPS%20statuses%20on%20their%20behalf.%5Cn%5CnCandidates%20should%20exercise%20caution%20and%20avoid%20sharing%20sensitive%20JAMB%20login%20details%2C%20passwords%20or%20other%20personal%20information%20with%20unauthorised%20persons.%5Cn%5CnAdmission-related%20information%20should%20be%20obtained%20through%20official%20JAMB%20channels%20and%20the%20recognised%20admission%20portals%20of%20respective%20institutions.%5Cn%5CnCandidates%20should%20also%20be%20wary%20of%20anyone%20demanding%20payment%20to%20restore%20access%20to%20their%20CAPS%20account%20or%20promising%20to%20influence%20an%20admission%20status.%5Cn%5Cn**JAMB%20TO%20PROVIDE%20FURTHER%20UPDATES**%5CnThe%20Board%20has%20indicated%20that%20updates%20will%20be%20provided%20as%20efforts%20to%20resolve%20the%20technical%20challenges%20progress.%5Cn%5CnUntil%20the%20platform%20is%20restored%2C%20candidates%20and%20institutions%20are%20advised%20to%20remain%20patient%20and%20await%20official%20communication%20from%20JAMB.%5Cn%5CnThe%20temporary%20outage%20highlights%20the%20importance%20of%20the%20CAPS%20platform%20in%20the%20admission%20process%2C%20particularly%20during%20periods%20when%20universities%20and%20other%20tertiary%20institutions%20are%20actively%20processing%20admissions.%5Cn%5CnOnce%20the%20technical%20challenges%20are%20resolved%20and%20the%20platform%20returns%20to%20full%20functionality%2C%20candidates%20should%20be%20able%20to%20resume%20checking%20their%20admission%20status%20and%20carrying%20out%20other%20activities%20available%20through%20JAMB%20CAPS.%5Cn%5CnFor%20now%2C%20candidates%20are%20advised%20not%20to%20panic%20if%20they%20are%20unable%20to%20access%20the%20platform.%20The%20Board%20has%20attributed%20the%20situation%20to%20technical%20challenges%20with%20its%20hosting%20arrangements%20and%20has%20confirmed%20that%20engagement%20is%20already%20ongoing%20to%20resolve%20the%20problem.%5Cn%5CnCandidates%2C%20institutions%20and%20other%20users%20are%20encouraged%20to%20stay%20updated%20through%20JAMB%E2%80%99s%20official%20communication%20channels%20for%20information%20on%20when%20the%20JAMB%20CAPS%20platform%20will%20be%20fully%20restored.%5Cn%5Cn%22%7D%5D]

title: WAEC RELEASES PREVIOUSLY WITHHELD 2026 EXAMINATION RESULTS
details: [SOH_BLOCKS:%5B%7B%22type%22%3A%22paragraph%22%2C%22text%22%3A%22**%20WAEC%20RELEASES%20PREVIOUSLY%20WITHHELD%202026%20EXAMINATION%20RESULTS**%5Cn%5CnThe%20West%20African%20Examinations%20Council%20(WAEC)%20has%20released%20a%20batch%20of%20previously%20withheld%20results%20from%20the%202026%20West%20African%20Senior%20School%20Certificate%20Examination%20(WASSCE).%5Cn%5CnThe%20development%20comes%20as%20good%20news%20to%20candidates%20whose%20results%20were%20withheld%20following%20the%20initial%20release%20of%20the%202026%20examination%20results.%5Cn%5CnCandidates%20whose%20results%20have%20now%20been%20cleared%20can%20log%20in%20to%20the%20official%20WAEC%20result-checking%20portal%20to%20confirm%20their%20updated%20status.%5Cn%5Cn**How%20to%20Check%20Your%20Released%20WAEC%20Result**%5Cn%5CnCandidates%20can%20check%20their%20results%20by%20following%20these%20steps%3A%5Cn%5Cn1.%20Visit%20the%20official%20WAEC%20result%20portal%3A%20www.waecdirect.org%5Cn2.%20Enter%20your%2010-digit%20WAEC%20Examination%20Number.%5Cn3.%20Select%20the%20Examination%20Year%3A%202026.%5Cn4.%20Select%20the%20appropriate%20Examination%20Type%20%E2%80%94%20School%20Candidate%20or%20Private%20Candidate.%5Cn5.%20Enter%20the%20Card%20Serial%20Number%20and%20PIN%20on%20your%20e-PIN%2Fresult%20checker%20card.%5Cn6.%20Click%20Submit%20to%20view%20your%20result.%5Cn7.%20You%20can%20also%20print%20your%20statement%20of%20result%20for%20your%20records.%5Cn%5Cn**What%20If%20Your%20Result%20Is%20Still%20Withheld%3F**%5Cn%5CnIf%20your%20result%20remains%20withheld%20after%20checking%2C%20there%20may%20be%20no%20need%20to%20panic.%20WAEC%20reviews%20withheld%20results%20in%20batches%20through%20its%20National%20Examinations%20Committee%20(NEC).%5Cn%5CnCandidates%20whose%20results%20have%20not%20yet%20been%20released%20should%20continue%20to%20monitor%20the%20official%20WAEC%20portal%20for%20updates.%5Cn%5CnSchool%20Candidates%5Cn%5CnCandidates%20who%20participated%20in%20the%20May%2FJune%20WASSCE%2 title: LAGOS STATE UNIVERSITY [LASU] RELEASES 2026/2027 JUPEB FOUNDATION PROGRAMME ADMISSION LIST

details: title: 37th LASUSU President, Rufai Akanni Obipehin, Announces Monthly Community Cleanup Exercise to Commemorate World Cleanup Day
summary: The 37th Lagos State University Students’ Union, led by President Rufai Akanni Obipehin, has announced a Monthly Students’ Community Cleanup Exercise, commencing on Saturday, October 24, 2026. The initiative aims to fulfil a campaign commitment while promoting environmental responsibility, improved sanitation and healthier living across student residential communities.

title: JAMB Set to Introduce Life Skills and Critical Thinking Questions in UTME
details: [SOH_BLOCKS:%5B%7B%22type%22%3A%22paragraph%22%2C%22text%22%3A%22The%20**Joint%20Admissions%20and%20Matriculation%20Board%20(JAMB)**%20has%20constituted%20a%20committee%20to%20develop%20a%20framework%20for%20incorporating%20life%20skills%20and%20critical%20thinking%20into%20the%20Unified%20Tertiary%20Matriculation%20Examination%20(UTME).%5Cn%5CnThe%20proposed%20review%20is%20aimed%20at%20assessing%20candidates%20beyond%20their%20knowledge%20of%20individual%20subjects%20and%20determining%20their%20ability%20to%20apply%20reasoning%20and%20problem-solving%20skills%20to%20real-life%20situations.%5Cn%5Cn**JAMB%20Reviews%20UTME%20Assessment%20Structure**%5CnSpeaking%20on%20the%20initiative%2C%20JAMB%20Registrar%2C%20Prof.%20Segun%20Aina%2C%20explained%20that%20the%20proposed%20review%20is%20intended%20to%20align%20the%20UTME%20with%20the%20changing%20demands%20of%20higher%20education.%5Cn%5CnAccording%20to%20him%2C%20candidates%20already%20undergo%20subject-based%20assessments%20through%20their%20Senior%20Secondary%20School%20examinations%20conducted%20by%20bodies%20such%20as%20the%20West%20African%20Examinations%20Council%20(WAEC)%20and%20the%20National%20Examinations%20Council%20(NECO).%5Cn%5CnThe%20review%20will%20therefore%20examine%20whether%20the%20existing%20UTME%20structure%20remains%20effective%20in%20predicting%20candidates%E2%80%99%20performance%20at%20the%20tertiary%20level.%5Cn%5Cn**Committee%20to%20Develop%20New%20Assessment%20Framework**%5CnJAMB%20has%20constituted%20a%20committee%20comprising%20stakeholders%20from%20various%20sectors%20of%20the%20education%20system%20and%20professional%20bodies.%5Cn%5CnThe%20committee%20includes%20representatives%20from%3A%5Cn%5CnUniversities%5CnExamination%20bodies%5CnProfessional%20regulatory%20councils%5CnStudents%E2%80%99%20groups%5CnSecondary%20schools%5CnDevelopment%20organisations%5CnThe%20committee%20has%20been%20given%20four%20weeks%20to%20submit%20its%20initial%20recommendations%20to%20JAMB.%5Cn%5Cn**Proposed%20Questions%20May%20Test%20Critical%20Thinking**%5CnThe%20proposed%20framework%20may%20assess%20skills%20such%20as%20analytical%20reasoning%2C%20logical%20reasoning%2C%20verbal%20reasoning%2C%20problem-solving%20and%20the%20ability%20to%20apply%20knowledge%20to%20practical%20situations.%5Cn%5CnThe%20Minister%20of%20Education%2C%20Dr%20Tunji%20Alausa%2C%20represented%20at%20the%20event%2C%20urged%20the%20committee%20to%20develop%20assessment%20methods%20that%20are%20fair%2C%20transparent%20and%20standardised.%5Cn%5CnThe%20proposed%20life%20skills%20and%20critical%20thinking%20components%20may%20be%20incorporated%20into%20existing%20UTME%20subjects%2C%20depending%20on%20the%20outcome%20of%20the%20committee%E2%80%99s%20review%20and%20JAMB%E2%80%99s%20subsequent%20consideration%20of%20its%20recommendations.%5Cn%5Cn**No%20Confirmed%20Change%20to%202027%20UTME%20Format%20Yet**%5CnIt%20is%20important%20for%20prospective%20UTME%20candidates%20to%20note%20that%20the%20proposed%20changes%20are%20still%20under%20review.%5Cn%5CnThe%20development%20does%20not%20currently%20represent%20a%20confirmed%20change%20to%20the%20UTME%20examination%20format.%20Candidates%20should%20therefore%20rely%20on%20official%20JAMB%20announcements%20for%20any%20final%20decision%20regarding%20the%20introduction%2C%20structure%20or%20implementation%20of%20the%20proposed%20assessment%20components.%5Cn%5Cn%5BCLICK%20ON%20THIS%20LINK%20TO%20FOLLOW%20S.O.H%20CONSULTS%20CHANNEL%20ON%20WHATSAPP%20FOR%20IMPORTANT%20UPDATES.%5D(https%3A%2F%2Fwhatsapp.com%2Fchannel%2F0029VbD6QQp3GJP68dl9TK29)%20%5Cn%5Cn%22%2C%22font%22%3A%22Times%20New%20Roman%22%2C%22spacing%22%3A%22normal%22%7D%5D]

title: JAMB Plans National Digital Pre-Registration App Ahead of 2027 UTME
summary: The Joint Admissions and Matriculation Board (JAMB) plans to introduce the National Digital Pre-Registration App ahead of the 2027 Unified Tertiary Matriculation Examination (UTME). This reform aims to streamline the registration process by allowing candidates to handle preparatory tasks on mobile devices before completing final verifications at physical centres
details: [SOH_BLOCKS:%5B%7B%22type%22%3A%22paragraph%22%2C%22text%22%3A%22The%20**Joint%20Admissions%20and%20Matriculation%20Board%20(JAMB)%20**%20has%20announced%20plans%20to%20introduce%20a%20National%20Digital%20Pre-Registration%20App%20(NDPA)%20ahead%20of%20the%202027%20Unified%20Tertiary%20Matriculation%20Examination%20(UTME).%5Cn%5CnThe%20proposed%20digital%20platform%20is%20designed%20to%20simplify%20the%20UTME%20registration%20process%20by%20allowing%20prospective%20candidates%20to%20complete%20key%20preparatory%20steps%20on%20their%20mobile%20phones%20before%20visiting%20accredited%20registration%20centres.%5Cn%5Cn**What%20Candidates%20Will%20Be%20Able%20to%20Do%20With%20the%20App**%5CnAccording%20to%20the%20information%20provided%20by%20JAMB%2C%20the%20National%20Digital%20Pre-Registration%20App%20will%20enable%20candidates%20to%20carry%20out%20several%20important%20activities%20before%20proceeding%20to%20an%20accredited%20registration%20centre.%5Cn%5Cn**These%20include**%3A%5Cn%5CnExploring%20available%20courses%20and%20programmes.%5CnChecking%20admission%20requirements.%5CnConfirming%20the%20appropriate%20UTME%20subject%20combinations.%5CnReviewing%20and%20confirming%20personal%20information.%5CnCompleting%20other%20preparatory%20steps%20ahead%20of%20physical%20registration.%5CnThe%20initiative%20is%20expected%20to%20give%20candidates%20a%20better%20understanding%20of%20the%20registration%20requirements%20before%20they%20visit%20a%20Computer-Based%20Test%20(CBT)%20centre.%5Cn%5Cn**JAMB%20Says%20App%20Will%20Reduce%20Registration%20Errors**%5CnJAMB%20explained%20that%20the%20proposed%20platform%20is%20part%20of%20its%20efforts%20to%20make%20the%20UTME%20registration%20process%20more%20efficient%20and%20convenient%20for%20candidates%20across%20the%20country.%5Cn%5CnThe%20Board%20said%20the%20app%20is%20expected%20to%20reduce%20registration%20errors%2C%20shorten%20the%20amount%20of%20time%20candidates%20spend%20at%20registration%20centres%2C%20and%20improve%20the%20overall%20registration%20experience.%5Cn%5CnThe%20platform%20is%20also%20expected%20to%20support%20different%20mobile%20devices%2C%20while%20some%20of%20its%20functions%20may%20be%20available%20without%20an%20active%20internet%20connection.%5Cn%5Cn**NDPA%20Will%20Not%20Replace%20CBT%20Centre%20Registration**%5CnJAMB%20has%20clarified%20that%20the%20National%20Digital%20Pre-Registration%20App%20will%20not%20replace%20the%20official%20UTME%20registration%20process.%5Cn%5CnCandidates%20will%20still%20be%20required%20to%20visit%20accredited%20JAMB%20registration%20centres%2FCBT%20centres%20for%20final%20verification%20and%20completion%20of%20their%20registration.%5Cn%5CnThe%20app%20will%20therefore%20serve%20primarily%20as%20a%20preparatory%20tool%2C%20helping%20candidates%20get%20their%20information%20and%20requirements%20ready%20before%20the%20final%20registration%20stage.%5Cn%5Cn**Part%20of%20JAMB%E2%80%99s%20Digital%20Reform**%5CnThe%20proposed%20introduction%20of%20the%20NDPA%20forms%20part%20of%20JAMB%E2%80%99s%20broader%20efforts%20to%20improve%20the%20efficiency%2C%20transparency%20and%20credibility%20of%20the%20tertiary%20admission%20process.%5Cn%5CnBy%20allowing%20candidates%20to%20prepare%20important%20registration%20details%20before%20reaching%20accredited%20centres%2C%20the%20initiative%20is%20expected%20to%20streamline%20the%20registration%20process%20and%20reduce%20avoidable%20mistakes.%5Cn%5CnCandidates%20preparing%20for%20the%202027%20UTME%20are%20therefore%20advised%20to%20follow%20official%20JAMB%20communications%20for%20further%20information%20on%20the%20launch%2C%20availability%20and%20approved%20procedures%20for%20using%20the%20National%20Digital%20Pre-Registration%20App.%5Cn%5Cn**ARE%20YOU%20PREPARING%20FOR%20THE%202027%20UTME%20EXAMINATION%3F**%5Cn%5CnJoin%20our%20WhatsApp%20channel%20below%20to%20receive%20first-hand%20information%2C%20important%20updates%2C%20registration%20guidelines%2C%20examination%20news%2C%20and%20other%20useful%20UTME%20i title: 2027 UTME: A SAFER START FOR CANDIDATE
summary: JAMB Adjusts 2027 UTME First Session Over Safety Concerns
details:
[SOH:BREAKING]
[SCHEDULE: 2026-09-15T18:12:00.000Z]
JAMB has adjusted the arrival time for candidates in the first UTME examination session, moving it from 6:30 a.m. to 7:00 a.m.

The adjustment is aimed at reducing the challenges associated with very early-morning travel, particularly for candidates travelling long distances to their CBT centres.

The decision was reached during the Board’s 2026 Management and IT Retreat, as part of efforts to make the 2027 UTME safer, more efficient and more convenient for candidates.

Please note: The new 7:00 a.m. arrival time applies to the first examination session. Further details on the complete 2027 UTME timetable will be communicated through JAMB’s official channels.

A safer journey. A better UTME experience.

title: WASSCE Private Candidate 2026 Second Series Registration Closes September 18
summary: Registration for the WASSCE for Private Candidates, 2026 Second Series is ongoing, with the deadline for PIN generation and completion of registration set for Friday, September 18, 2026.
details: The West African Examinations Council (WAEC) has announced that normal registration for the WASSCE for Private Candidates, 2026 Second Series will close on Friday, September 18, 2026. Intending candidates are advised to generate their registration PIN and complete their biometric capturing and online registration on or before 11:59 PM on the closing date. Candidates who are yet to complete their registration are advised to do so before the deadline to avoid missing the examination registration window.
